lineageCriteria.groupingRule: Evaluation groups are connected components formed by shared source base or trajectory overlap meeting the bidirectional coverage criterion. Near-duplicate starts are reported as dependence warnings but do not alone merge groups unless their captured trajectories overlap.

independence.warning: Frames, trajectories and source-base groups are not interchangeable. The fixed Unity anatomy does not support patient/anatomy generalization claims.
